verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform that hosts agents and sandboxes and offers a model gateway, so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no training-data policy, no opt-out setting, and no contractual no-training commitment. The egress allowlists and denylists for preventing exfiltration from sandboxes concern outbound network traffic, not model training.
